{"predictors": [
{"name": "Revenue Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of revenue sources (e.g., customer, product, geographic) over the past 3 years using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with more concentrated revenue streams may face greater earnings uncertainty and risk, leading to higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Volatility", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of year-over-year changes in total employees (Compustat item EMP) over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile employee growth may experience greater operational uncertainty, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "Count the number of unique suppliers (identified via Thomson Reuters' Worldscope database) and divide by total assets (Compustat item AT) over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with more complex supply chains may face greater logistical and operational risks, resulting in higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Regulatory Exposure", "construction": "Calculate the proportion of industry-level (NAICS 4-digit) environmental regulatory actions (from the US EPA's Enforcement and Compliance database) affecting the firm over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms facing greater environmental regulatory exposure may incur higher compliance costs and face greater uncertainty, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Innovation Network Centrality", "construction": "Compute the eigenvector centrality of each firm in a patent citation network (using USPTO data) over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms at the center of innovation networks may have greater access to knowledge and resources, leading to higher growth opportunities and expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Overcommitment", "construction": "Calculate the average number of other board members' committee assignments (from Thomson Reuters' BoardEx database) for each firm's board members over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with overcommitted board members may experience weaker governance and oversight, leading to higher agency costs and expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Stickiness", "construction": "Compute the ratio of average revenue per customer (using Compustat item REVT and number of customers from Thomson Reuters' Worldscope) to customer acquisition costs (estimated via industry reports and firm 10-K filings) over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with stickier customer bases may enjoy greater pricing power and lower churn rates, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Disclosure Timing Consistency", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of quarterly earnings announcement dates (from Thomson Reuters' StreetEvents database) over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more consistent disclosure timing may experience lower information asymmetry and uncertainty, leading to lower expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Market Fluidity", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl index of industry-level (NAICS 4-digit) product market shares (from Compustat and Census Bureau data) over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms operating in more fluid product markets may face greater competitive uncertainty, leading to higher required returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Earnings Persistence", "construction": "Calculate the autocorrelation of quarterly earnings (from Compustat) for each geographic segment (from Thomson Reuters' Worldscope) over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more persistent geographic earnings may experience greater stability and lower uncertainty, leading to lower expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
